rules: Real money. ETFs only, whole shares, limit orders only.
Preview every order with review_equity_order first; place it only after the user replies yes to that specific order in chat.
No standing approval: a yes covers one order.
Sells before buys; never let buys exceed buying power or the budget.
Change budget or symbol lists only when the user says so.
Dollar-based market orders, regular hours only, approved ETFs only, buys only.
Each batch still needs the user's explicit yes.

core.rules: Long-term ETF mix; rebalance only on 5-point drift; one yes per batch.

daytrade.grantedBy: user, in chat, 2026-10-13 ~9:50 PM ET: goal 1.5% daily, 'if you have to become a day trader so be it'; chose a $2,000 sleeve with one approval per trade package
daytrade.resized: user, in chat, 2026-10-15: 'invest 75% instead 50%', then 'Yes sell as listed' (sell half of each core holding, about $991, queued for the Oct 16 open, settles T+1 Mon Oct 19). Max loss per trade stays at $40 until the sleeve shows results.
daytrade.approval: One explicit user yes per trade package. A package is the entry limit order, its protective stop order and the time exit. Nothing is placed without that yes.
rules: Cash account: only settled cash may be used. One round trip per dollar per day, to avoid good-faith violations.
Entry: a limit order at or near the ask. Immediately after the fill, a protective stop order sits at Robinhood, so the stop works even if the session is idle.
Stops are set from volatility (about 2x the 5-minute ATR), and share count is cut so that the loss at the stop is at most $40 (maxLossPerTradeUsd).
Time exit: flat by 3:50 PM ET unless the package says otherwise and the user approved it.
Daily loss stop: if the sleeve is down 4% (about $120) on the day, propose nothing more that day.
Drawdown halt: at 20% below the sleeve's high (about $600), stop and review with the user.
Never size up to catch the 1.5% target.
